# KiCad native reference artifact

This directory is generated by:

```text
cargo run -p jingwei-kicad-schematic --example generate_native_fixture -- testdata/logical/reports/kicad-native
```

The fixture is synthetic and licensed CC0-1.0. It exercises the Task 03
`SchematicGraph -> KicadProjectionModel -> .kicad_sch` path with two embedded
symbols, four stable pin UUIDs and two named logical nets. Generated files are
kept together here:

- `jingwei-native-reference.kicad_sch`: native KiCad schematic;
- `jingwei-native-reference.object-map.json`: JIR-to-KiCad traceability map;
- `jingwei-native-symbols.kicad_sym`: deterministic project-local symbol library;
- `sym-lib-table`: project-local library registration for KiCad/ERC;
- `jingwei-native-reference.kicad_pro`: minimal project anchor for local-library lookup;
- `jingwei-native-reference.projection.json`: typed intermediate projection;
- `jingwei-native-reference.summary.json`: structural parser result;
- `jingwei-native-reference.erc.json`: KiCad 10.0.5 ERC output;
- `rendered/jingwei-native-reference.svg`: KiCad 10.0.5 rendering;
- `jingwei-native-reference-gui-saved.kicad_sch`: KiCad 10.0.5 upgraded save;
- `jingwei-native-reference-gui-saved.kicad_pro`: GUI-created project anchor;
- `jingwei-native-reference-gui-saved.summary.json`: parser result after GUI save;
- `jingwei-native-reference-gui-saved.erc.json`: ERC after GUI save.

The native writer uses KiCad's stable `20220904` S-expression schema. KiCad
10.0.5 reads it directly and upgrades it to `20260306` when saved. Both the
generated and GUI-saved schematics pass KiCad 10.0.5 CLI ERC with zero
violations. GUI session history, lock and preference files are intentionally
kept outside the repository under the external `.tooling/kicad` test archive.
